text.title: 留在纸上的话
text.situation:
乔再次戴上耳机，开始把采访转写成文字。书面记录让核查某个日期更方便，不必重听整段录音。她保留了负责人对临时入口的描述，又请一位访客讲述从公交站走来的过程。录音前，她解释片段将如何使用，访客口头表示同意。诺拉写下双方同意的事项，方便团队日后核查。她们没有把一句口头“可以”当作所有用途的许可。乔站在窗边朗读转写稿，一句话听起来不对，于是回到录音，而不是猜测说话人的意思。

诺拉：能讲讲你走来的路线吗？
访客：我经过侧门，沿着指示牌走。
乔：我们可以在本周节目中使用这段回答吗？
访客：可以，用在那一期里。

paragraphs.en: Jo put on the headphones again and began to transcribe the interview. The written record made it easier to check a date without playing the whole recording. She kept the manager’s description of the temporary entrance, then asked a visitor to give an account of the journey from the bus stop. Before recording it, she explained how the clip would be used. The visitor gave verbal agreement; Nora wrote down what had been agreed so that the team could check it later. No one treated a spoken yes as permission for every possible use. By the window, Jo read the transcript aloud. One sentence sounded wrong. She returned to the audio rather than guessing what the speaker had meant.

paragraphs.en:
Nora: Could you give an account of the route?
Visitor: I walked past the side gate and followed the sign.
Jo: May we use that answer in this week’s programme?
Visitor: Yes, in that programme.

S16.N05.P01.function: The words that stayed on the page
S16.N05.P01.cue: 说说书面记录和入口描述。
acceptableAnswers: 书面记录使日期易于核查。 描述说明了临时入口。

S16.N05.P02.function: The words that stayed on the page
S16.N05.P02.cue: 说说访客的回答如何变成文字。
acceptableAnswers: 访客叙述了步行经过。 乔把采访转写成文字。

S16.N05.P03.function: The words that stayed on the page
S16.N05.P03.cue: 说说双方同意了什么，以及如何表示同意。
acceptableAnswers: 访客作出了口头回答。 诺拉记下访客的口头同意。
